findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed touching ready to eat fries with their bare hands. Education was carried out. The packet of fries was discarded. Ensure that employee are knowledgeable and always remember to avoid bare handling ready to eat food items by donning gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following was observed the following.
1. The internal surface of the coffee maker was observed soiled. (COS)
2. The nozzles of the soda machine in the lobby were observed to have a buildup of soil accumulation.

Discussed with PIC. The nozzles were removed to be cleaned and the coffee maker was cleaned and sanitized.  The soda machine will be out of order until the nozzles are cleaned properly. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the coffee maker and soda machine nozzles are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized on a regular basis. Inspector will return on 05/08/26 to followup on the nozzles.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observed visible light coming through the back exit door at the bottom and top area. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the necessary repair will be done to have the door sealed properly discouraging the entry of pests. Ensure that the spaces allowing light to pass through are sealed properly.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The coving tiles on the wall left of the tea brewing station by the ice machine was observed coming off the wall. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the necessary repairs will be done. Ensure that the coving tiles are sealed appropriately to the wall providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(B) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrier to shut off the faucet after washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and this was corrected. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable about using a barrier to shut off the faucet after washing their hands to avoid recontaminating their hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/dust/soils:
-The gaskets of the coolers 10 and 11.
-The gasket of the hash brown freezer.
-The walk-in cooler fan cages.
-The air intakes of the equipment along the frozen coke machine and surrounding equipment.
Ensure these areas are cleaned to remove the current accumulation of food debris/dust/soils and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The bottom of the McCafe cooler has an accumulation of water. PIC was made aware of this accumulation and will be cleaning the bottom of the cooler and having repairs made to the cooler drain to ensure it is functioning properly. Ensure that the water accumulation is cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the pooling of water until the machine is able to be repaired. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The spray nozzle at the triple sink is observed to have a leak present. PIC stated that new parts have been ordered from two separate stores out of precaution of one being potentially back ordered. PIC stated repairs will be completed once the part has been delivered. A follow-up is being issued for 6-10-2024 to observe this item.
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.
